answer: Quadratic collateral lockup forms a kernel where each validator stakes proportionally to the square of its delegation, so any Sybil cluster must forge capital that grows super-linearly by a factor of two per identity. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay embeds an ember of time-locked slashing, making deviation penalties exceed the maximal extractable reward and yielding negative expected utility. Thus the protocol reaches a robust Nash equilibrium securing consensus and finality.
